item.title: Proposal for better renovation of path and French drain to carry rainwater, 25th August
item.description:
This pathway can become hazardous to use because it becomes the route for a running stream of water at times of heavy rainfall. It is proposed that a French drain is installed to carry rainwater down the hill next to the path, and that the degraded path is properly renovated, not just patched. Heavier rain due to climate change will make this problem worse in the future if no action is taken.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Rangefield Road, Sundridge, Greater London
